label.en: Spot documents that have stopped moving

label.fr: Retrouver une information dans mes données

asked.en: What do you want to achieve?

asked.fr: Vos documents portent-ils un statut (en cours, terminé…) ?
asked.en: Do your documents carry a status (in progress, done…)?

asked.fr: Chaque document a-t-il un identifiant qui ne change pas ?
asked.en: Does each document have an identifier that never changes?

fr.title: Surveiller les documents qui n'avancent plus
fr.says: lumnik peut déclarer le cycle de vie d'une colonne de statut et alerter quand un document reste dans le même état au-delà d'un seuil.
does-not-say: L'immobilité est mesurée depuis la première observation par lumnik, jamais depuis la date d'entrée dans votre ERP.
Un document sans identifiant n'est pas suivi.
La surveillance porte sur les données d'une source telles qu'elles sont reçues, pas sur une fiche fusionnée de plusieurs sources.

en.title: Watch documents that have stopped moving
en.says: lumnik can declare the lifecycle of a status column and alert when a document stays in the same state beyond a threshold.
does-not-say: Stillness is measured from lumnik's first observation, never from the date the document entered your ERP.
A document without an identifier is not followed.
Monitoring applies to one source's data as received, not to a record merged from several sources.

conditions.target: the document table and its status column, designated by the integrator
conditions.confirmed-when: a workflow apply report for a Workflow whose spec.on.table and spec.on.column are exactly the designated table and column, with tableMissing false and checkUnavailable false
conditions.refuted-when: a workflow apply report for that same binding, with tableMissing false and an unavailableReason carrying SQLSTATE 42703 (never the bare checkUnavailable flag)

label.fr: Cette colonne décrit le cycle de vie du document
label.en: That column describes the document's lifecycle

conditions.property: existence is provable; business meaning is not — an integrator attestation, recorded with its origin

conditions.target: the key column (spec.on.key), designated by the integrator
conditions.confirmed-when: a workflow apply report for a Workflow whose spec.on.table is the designated table and whose spec.on.key is exactly the designated key column, with tableMissing false, checkUnavailable false and keyColumnMissing false
conditions.refuted-when: a workflow apply report for that same binding, with tableMissing false and keyColumnMissing true

label.en: The identifier durably designates each document

note.fr: L'intégrateur doit établir que la clé identifie durablement chaque document suivi. Le contrôle actuel ne vérifie pas cette garantie.
note.en: The integrator must establish that the key durably identifies each tracked document. The current check does not verify this guarantee.

label.fr: La cible choisie est acceptée par la validation de la surveillance
label.en: The chosen target is accepted by the monitoring validation

conditions.property: the target passes the dormancy validation — nothing about its existence or physical nature
conditions.confirmed-when: an earlier human apply was accepted (200) for a Workflow declaring spec.dormancy with spec.on.table exactly the designated target
conditions.refuted-when: an earlier human apply was refused with 'spec.dormancy cannot be declared on a fused entity view' for that exact target
